prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: modular pixel-art sprite atlas for a 1990s Neo Geo side-view run-and-gun boss fight, used at native low resolution.
Create one original enemy industrial war machine, a very wide squat suspended armored command cabin, viewed straight from the front, facing the viewer. It hangs above the player in an aircraft carrier elevator shaft. Rounded olive-gray riveted tank armor, heavy rusty ochre bevels, hoses and chunky hydraulic machinery, little scarlet insignia with no text, deep ink outlines, deliberate crisp pixel clusters, exaggerated hand-drawn arcade proportions like Metal Slug hardware. NOT a humanoid mecha, NO legs, NO sleek spaceship, NO photorealism or 3D render.
Atlas layout on genuinely transparent background, 1536x1024. All parts separated with clear empty margins. Upper two thirds: main wide boss hull, approx bounds x220..1310 y80..580. Center top of hull contains large open black cockpit window with visible menacing bald officer with dark beard, broad square jaw, red military collar, scar over one eye, hands at controls. Large heavy steel collar around window. Bottom center exposed round ribbed copper reactor core with glowing amber slots, aimed downwards. Left and right shoulder sockets for mounting separate weapons. Scuffed rounded armor, asymmetry, vents and small pipes.
Bottom left quadrant: ONE detached matching cannon pod pointing straight down, approx x130..440 y700..980, cylindrical double-barrel turret with joint at top, muzzle below. Bottom middle: ONE detached hydraulic claw/drill pod pointing down x620..900 y700..980. Bottom right: ONE short vertical rail and pulley module x1120..1350 y700..980. Parts must NOT overlap or touch.
Rendering: very strong readable shapes, limited dark olive/steel/brown palette with cream highlights, warm orange weak core. Black silhouette outlines, stepped shadows, visible hand-placed pixel clusters. No glow fog, ground, backdrop, labels, text, watermark, or checkerboard. Transparent alpha only around sprites.
backgroundExtractionAttempt: Precise-object-edit for sprite atlas production. Keep every machine part and pixel of the attached sprite atlas exactly unchanged, same size, positions, canvas. Replace ONLY the brown/black gradient backdrop with a perfectly flat solid bright magenta #ff00ff. Make the magenta fill all empty space between disconnected parts and gaps outside their silhouettes. NO shadows on background, NO gradient, NO checkerboard. Preserve dark outlines and dark interior cockpit. This is chroma-key source for game sprites.
note: Extraction attempt retained gradient; runtime silhouette masks exclude the background.
